title: unu garages v2
description: Curated list of garages that service unu electric scooters. Short-key encoding: n=name, p=phone (E.164), s=street and house number, z=postal code, c=city, cc=ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, ll=[lat,lng] WGS84, w=website, d=official unu dealer (1), lp=Librescoot partner garage (1), r=confirmed unu repairs (-1 unknown, 0 no, 1 yes), a=new-customer access (all|existing), src=where the entry's data came from (research|community|garage|manufacturer), v=verification date. garages_v2.json contains the entries with r=1 or d=1; garages-source.json carries the full curated set, including unverified entries.

s.description: Street and house number (canonical local spelling)

z.description: Postal code (string: NL/CH/etc. contain letters; leading zeros preserved)

c.description: City (canonical postal city, without district suffixes)

ll.description: [latitude, longitude] in WGS84, rounded to 5 decimals (~1 m)

d.description: Official unu dealer: 1=yes, 0=no. Only present on published entries when 1.

r.description: Confirmed unu repair service: 1=yes, 0=no, -1=unknown. Published garages_v2.json contains entries with r=1 or d=1.

a.description: New-customer access: all=accepts new customers, existing=existing customers only (Bestandskunden). Only present on published entries when 'existing'.

src.description: Where the entry's data came from: research=Librescoot's own check against first-party sources, community=a user or community report, garage=stated by the garage itself, manufacturer=listed by unu/emco as an official dealer. Only present on published entries when not 'research'.

lp.description: Librescoot partner garage: 1=yes, 0=no. Only present on published entries when 1.
